statusFile.label: Watchdog status file
statusFile.help: statusFile of the watchdog config of this host, e.g. /var/lib/scada/watchdog-status.json

apiSocket.label: Watchdog API
apiSocket.help: Empty: watchdog.sock next to the status file, or the pipe scada-redundancy-watchdog on Windows

iobrokerJson.label: iobroker.json to check
iobrokerJson.help: Empty: the iobroker.json of this host

installHelp.text: The watchdog runs as a service of the operating system (systemd, launchd or Windows service), so it keeps working when ioBroker stops. Install it once with the command in the state redundancy.0.watchdogInstall.
